title: Exploring the Dream Realm
text: The upper Dawn Crystal Fields are bright islands of yellow-white Light Condensate. The lower Shadow Woodland grows dark trees and berries on violet-black rock. They provide the materials of light and dark.

Sparse mirror-rock islands occupy the middle Mirror Dream Border, where Dream Crystal Budding Rock can be found. The Radiant Courtyard, Shadow Library and Ruined Mirror-Dream Gallery lie in their corresponding layers.
Prepare a return route and safe landings before crossing gaps. Identify the layer and nearby creatures before searching for materials and ruins.
